import unittest

from reports.export import export_csv


class ExportCsvTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic(self):
        rows = [{"a": 1, "b": "x"}, {"a": 2, "b": "y"}]
        result = export_csv(rows, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result, "a,b\r\n1,x\r\n2,y\r\n")

    def test_quoting_and_doubling(self):
        rows = [{"a": 'he said "hi"', "b": "line1\nline2"}]
        result = export_csv(rows, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result, 'a,b\r\n"he said ""hi""","line1\nline2"\r\n')

    def test_missing_and_none(self):
        rows = [{"a": None, "c": 3}]
        result = export_csv(rows, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result, "a,b\r\n,\r\n")

    def test_one_shot_generators(self):
        rows = ({"a": i} for i in range(3))
        cols = (c for c in ["a"])
        result = export_csv(rows, cols)
        self.assertEqual(result, "a\r\n0\r\n1\r\n2\r\n")

    def test_empty_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([], ["a"]), "a\r\n")

    def test_empty_columns(self):
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([{"a": 1}], []), "\r\n\r\n")

    def test_unicode(self):
        result = export_csv([{"a": "caf\u00e9"}], ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(result, "a\r\ncaf\u00e9\r\n")

    def test_invalid_columns(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], ["a", "a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], [1])

    def test_no_input_mutation(self):
        rows = [{"a": 1}]
        cols = ["a"]
        export_csv(rows, cols)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"a": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(cols, ["a"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
